value.rationale: The exact number of connected components of the reciprocal-square range for a classical, multiplicative, bi-unitary divisor system is a natural invariant. The complete interval classification has meaningful contrast with published disconnected ordinary and unitary ranges and identifies the structurally special \(p=2\) exponent-two factor bridging the gaps. It is not a small numerical optimization or routine substitution: an unconditional infinite prime-tail argument and a distinct eight-scale calculation are required.
